title: Final design pass on the Remote Sessions UI
body:
Last design pass on the Remote Sessions UI. A designer reviewed each surface from code; these are the points still open after the first round of fixes. Fix them all; no new features beyond what is listed. Theme tokens only, no hard-coded colours or sizes where siblings use theme values.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (UI sections). Files: src/remotes_pane.rs, src/remote_dir_prompt.rs, src/launcher.rs, src/hover_menu.rs, src/wm.rs, src/terminal.rs, src/panel.rs.
Blocked by: Launcher where-strip, directory prompt and split inheritance
Launcher and directory prompt (commit 87c10eb):
L1. A wrong directory answer is permanent. wm.rs answer_dir saves the answer before the launch is tried, remote::launch_dir then returns it forever, and the Remotes pane has no editor for Remote::dirs (its form only carries dirs through). A typo makes every launch and split from that Project on that Remote die on the cd error with no way out in the app. Add the per-Project directories to the Remotes pane edit form (list each Project directory with its Remote directory, edit and clear, same stacked label/field style, saves through the debounced write) and make the prompt copy say where to change it later (Settings > Remotes).
L2. Reach state is hover-only. Add one dim state line under the where-strip that names the selected Remote and its state in words ("desk: offline - no answer on port 22"), with a reserved fixed height so nothing jumps; shorten the tooltip and omit the target when it equals the name.
L3. Where a launch goes is not restated. With a Remote selected, section headers read "AGENTS ON DESK" / "SHELLS ON DESK" (which also explains why the local shell rows are gone). Keep the selected segment scrolled into view whenever the selection changes, not only when the menu opens, and show an overflow cue (edge fade or dim chevrons) when the strip is wider than STRIP_MAX_W.
L4. DirPrompt::show does not say what it is about to open; Ask.what and Ask.place are unused in the copy. Say it ("Open Claude on desk" / "Open a shell on desk"), so a prompt raised by a keyboard split is not a mystery. Check the "Directory" label fits LABEL_W.
Do NOT add a keyboard path to the hover launcher strip in this card; that is an open decision for the human. Say so in the final report.
Remotes pane (after commit b666f2d):
P1. status_line reserves one 18 pt line but OFFLINE_WHY and the Test summaries are 100 to 135 characters and wrap to 2 or 3 lines at minimum width, so rows still jump when a Test lands or selection passes an Offline row. Keep it to one line: truncate with one_line plus the full text on hover, or shorten the copy.
P2. RemotesView::hint: the row-selected and edit hints wrap near minimum width while the Add-row hint does not, shifting the list by a line. Make every hint fit one line at PANE_MIN_W.
P3. render_form: the error line appears above add/cancel with no reserved space and no scroll request, so at minimum height the buttons can slip under the scroll edge. Reserve the line or scroll to it.
Disconnect bar (after commit 34dbe27):
D1. A disconnected background tab is still invisible when its title is cut. refresh_exit_titles appends DISCONNECTED_MARK at the END of the title, which the tab chip fade and the Sessions-panel elision cut first. Add a cue that survives truncation: a theme danger dot or dimmed treatment on the tab icon and the panel row icon (snapped to device pixels like icons::paint_globe_badge, not colliding with the globe badge), with the marker text kept for wide tabs.
D2. reconnect_banner prints "reconnecting to desk" for a restored Session that never connected, while its bar says "Enter to connect". Print "connecting to" for that case.
Code-review points on the same commit (small, do all):
C1. A split or new terminal from a Remote Session whose Remote was deleted only toasts "X is no longer a Remote" (wm.rs start_remote); the Session can never be split again. Fall back to a Local split with the toast saying so. If a Remote with the same name now has a different target than the Session's own remote_target, treat it as a different Remote (Local fallback plus toast), never a silent redirect.
C2. Launch::Where(i) carries an index that apply_launch_path resolves against the live Remotes list a frame later; carry the Remote name instead. Clear a Project's launch_on when its name no longer resolves, so re-adding a Remote of that name does not silently reselect it.
C3. answer_dir stores the Project directory key verbatim, so a canonicalized Project writes a \\?\ key into settings.json and the new directories editor would show it. Strip the verbatim prefix on write (same_dir keeps matching old keys).
C4. If the Project closed while the directory prompt was open, the answer is saved and nothing opens with no message; toast it. Do not overwrite a mapping that was added in Settings for the same Project while the prompt was open without saying so.
Done when:
- a Project directory mapping can be edited and cleared in the Remotes pane (pure-model unit tests), and the prompt names the action, the Remote and where to change the answer
- layout tests through egui::Context::run at PANE_MIN_W show the status line and the hint are one line tall in every state, and the form buttons stay inside the pane with an error showing
- the launcher model test for zero Remotes is still unchanged; with a Remote selected the headers carry its name (unit test)
- a disconnected background Session has a non-text cue (unit test on the model that decides it)
- the full test suite passes
- the final report gives the complete list of states the human should capture with build-screenshot for the whole feature (Remotes pane, launcher strip, directory prompt, globe badge, disconnect bar, close confirm, toasts)
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
